notes: Primary NYC db nyc_crashes_2026 abandoned: NYC Open Data crashes/persons/vehicles max crash_date is 2026-06-11 (0 rows from 2026-07-01). Fallback Chicago used. crashes date range ('2026-07-01T00:11:00.000', '2026-10-21T01:00:00.000'). Dropped person residence (city/state/zip), licence, EMS run, carrier and commercial-vehicle ID fields. contributory_causes is a derived lookup (category column is a builder heuristic). Whole-crash deterministic ~80% sample (hash of crash_record_id) to fit 60 MB. Units with duplicate vehicle_id had the duplicate set to null.
